source:
@@U04651@@
Protect yourselves! Huddle close! Stand fast! Ah! Ah! They've lost it, their valor! Where's courage gone? My devils scent a strange, voluptuous glow.

@@U04653@@
Flowers so beautiful, Flames burning bright, On hearts that are dutiful Shed pure delight, Love every way. Words with pure truth that ring, Clear as heavens opening, To hosts immortal bring Everywhere day.

@@U04655@@
Ah, the fools! The dolts! My Satans standing on their heads, the fat ones turning cartwheels head over heels and tumbling ass-first into Hell! Oh, and I hope it agrees with you! But I’m standing by my post, no matter what.

@@U04656@@
(Beating off the roses floating down around him.)

@@U04657@@
Will-o’-the-wisps, away! Ah, you shine so brightly till Pve caught you, and then you're a sticky mess Away, I say! Now! Ah, there’s something like pitch and sulfur nipping at my neck!
translation:
@@U04651@@
保护好自己！凑近了！坚守！啊!啊!他们失去了勇气！勇气去哪儿了？我的魔鬼闻到了一种奇怪的、性感的光芒。

@@U04653@@
花朵如此美丽，火焰燃烧明亮，在尽责的心上洒下纯粹的喜悦，爱无处不在。纯净真理的话语响起， 清澈如天开， 给不朽的主人带来无处不在的日子。

@@U04655@@
啊，傻瓜们！笨蛋们！我的撒旦们倒立着，那些胖子们翻滚着翻滚，屁股先着地跌入地狱！哦，我希望你同意！但无论如何，我都会坚持我的立场。

@@U04656@@
（击落飘落在他周围的玫瑰。）

@@U04657@@
鬼火，走开！啊，你是如此耀眼，直到 Pve 抓住你，然后你就变成一团粘糊糊的东西了，我说！现在！啊，有像沥青和硫磺一样的东西咬住了我的脖子！
